economic_evaluation.fc_average_efficiency_source: frozen formal-curve arithmetic mean; project comparison parameter
economic_evaluation.soc_correction: signed; no clipping; no additional battery efficiency factor
economic_evaluation.degradation_costs: unchanged original formal interval ledger, including EOL caps
economic_evaluation.evaluation_scope: complete independent voyages only; never training reward
economic_evaluation.raw_load_handling: retain raw load; execute existing normalize_onboard_load_kw deadband
economic_evaluation.terminal_fc_accounting: no synthetic shutdown action; final executed FC state retained
economic_evaluation.fc_start_stop_accounting: existing model: 0-to-positive charges one startup cycle; positive-to-0 does not add another complete startup cycle
economic_evaluation.actual_hydrogen_method: original instantaneous formal fuel-cell efficiency curve

fc_curve_source.interpolation: existing formal shape-preserving PCHIP efficiency map

units.smooth_l1: native nonlinear objective, not converted economic cost

scope: Recorded completed rounds only; no data loading, optimization, or RNG sampling; missing values remain null
